_note: Key: eclipse_type → natal_planet_activated → aspect_type. 2×12=24 blocks. ~100 words.
fallback: An eclipse can bring a turning point into view before its implications are fully clear. External circumstances may expose a pressure point or reveal where an old arrangement no longer fits. The resulting shift often opens room for development, even when the transition initially feels disorienting. Notice what changes around the event, particularly where plans, priorities, or expectations are being revised. Let patterns emerge before making commitments that are difficult to unwind.

Solar.fallback: A solar eclipse concentrates vitality around a new direction. A clearer sense of purpose may surface through opportunities, visibility, or a change in momentum. Rather than requiring an immediate answer, this period often shows where self-expression wants more room. The decisions that follow can be shaped by what feels sustainable as well as exciting. Consider how your public choices, creative aims, and private values can begin moving in the same direction.
Solar.1: A solar eclipse in the first house brings your presence and self-definition into sharper focus. Changes in how you present yourself may signal that an older role has become too narrow. Visibility can increase without you needing to force it, especially when your choices reflect who you are becoming. A new direction may arrive through a simple act of self-recognition. Let your outward expression develop at a pace that feels honest, rather than performing certainty for someone else's comfort.
Solar.2: This eclipse emphasizes the relationship between resources, self-worth, and what you are willing to sustain. A financial adjustment or new opportunity may reveal which habits support genuine security and which ones only create short-term relief. Your sense of value is part of the story, not merely the numbers involved. Practical changes can work best when they reflect both present needs and future priorities. Review the structures around earning, spending, and receiving before deciding what deserves more investment.
Solar.3: A solar eclipse in the third house can reset the way information moves through your life. Conversations, local developments, study, or a new line of inquiry may place a question in sharper focus. The words you choose could carry farther than expected, particularly within close networks. This is less about having every answer than noticing where curiosity is leading. Keep records, ask precise questions, and give important agreements enough time for their meaning to become clear.
Solar.4: Home, family patterns, and emotional foundations come into view under this eclipse. A change in household circumstances may reveal which forms of belonging still feel supportive and which ones have become inherited obligations. Security may need to be defined on your own terms rather than by past expectations. The work is often quiet, but it can reshape everything built above it. Create room for the routines, boundaries, and surroundings that help you feel settled.
Solar.5: Creative desire and personal joy receive renewed emphasis here. A project, attraction, performance, or playful impulse may show you where self-expression has been waiting for permission. The eclipse can mark a shift in how openly you inhabit pleasure, romance, or artistic risk. There is no need to manufacture spontaneity; attention to what genuinely animates you is enough. Let the work or connection develop through interest, not through pressure to make it immediately meaningful.
Solar.6: The sixth-house eclipse points toward the systems that carry ordinary life: work, health, maintenance, and service. A disruption in routine may expose an inefficient arrangement or clarify a need your body has been trying to communicate. Small revisions can have lasting effects when they are practical enough to repeat. The goal is not perfection; it is a pattern that leaves more energy available for the rest of your life. Choose one workable adjustment and build from there.
Solar.7: Partnerships and agreements become a site of renewal with this eclipse. Another person's needs, expectations, or presence may bring an existing relational pattern into focus. A connection can deepen when both people have room to be distinct, and some arrangements may reveal their limits more clearly. Honest negotiation matters more than dramatic resolution. Name what reciprocity looks like for you, then pay attention to whether the relationship can meet that standard.
Solar.8: A solar eclipse in the eighth house brings shared resources, trust, and emotional exchange into sharper relief. Financial ties or private vulnerabilities may ask for a more direct conversation than they have received before. What has been carried alone can become easier to understand when its terms are made visible. This is a threshold for changing how power is shared, not a demand for immediate exposure. Approach commitments carefully, and make sure support remains mutual rather than one-sided.
Solar.9: Questions of meaning, learning, travel, or worldview can take on new momentum now. A course of study, encounter with another culture, or challenge to a familiar belief may widen your sense of what is possible. The eclipse does not require abandoning every certainty; it invites closer examination of the ones that guide your choices. Follow the questions with staying power. A teacher, text, or journey may become useful when it expands discernment rather than simply confirming what you already know.
Solar.10: The solar eclipse highlights vocation, public direction, and the role you are growing into. A professional opening or shift in visibility may reveal a path that deserves more deliberate attention. Ambition is most useful when it is connected to values rather than borrowed expectations. This period can clarify what you want your work to stand for, even before every logistical detail is solved. Take visible steps where they are warranted, while leaving room for the larger direction to mature.
Solar.11: Friendships, collaborators, and longer-range hopes come into focus under this eclipse. A group may offer access to a new future, or it may show where your aspirations have outgrown an old social setting. The people around you can influence what feels possible, so alignment matters. This is a good moment to notice which communities make space for your actual goals. Invest in mutual projects that encourage contribution, experimentation, and sustained connection.
Solar.12: The twelfth-house solar eclipse works below the surface, often through rest, solitude, memory, or an emerging awareness of what needs release. Private shifts may precede any visible change, and that does not make them less important. A habit of withdrawal can be examined with compassion when it no longer protects what it once did. Keep your schedule spacious enough to notice quieter signals. Renewal may begin with fewer demands and a more deliberate relationship to your inner life.

Conjunction.Vertex: Some arrivals announce themselves quietly and change everything anyway. A solar eclipse on your Vertex is one of those moments — what enters the field now carries the weight of a genuine threshold. A person, opportunity, institution, or circumstance may appear that reorients the current chapter in ways that only become clear with time. Eclipse contacts here tend to initiate rather than develop gradually. Notice what shows up in the weeks surrounding this date and treat it with the seriousness it is offering.

Opposition.Vertex: A solar eclipse opposing your Vertex activates the fated axis from the far side — through relationship, negotiation, or a situation that arrives carrying someone else’s momentum. What enters the field may feel like it belongs to another person’s story at first. It does not. The Vertex axis runs in both directions, and what comes through others still arrives for you. Stay clear about your own position as the contact unfolds. The most useful thing you can offer this moment is an honest read of where you actually stand.

Lunar.fallback: A lunar eclipse brings an emotional or relational process toward a visible culmination. Something that has been building in the background may now ask for recognition, closure, or a different response. Feelings can be useful data, particularly when they reveal an attachment that no longer supports your well-being. The event may mark an ending, but it can also clarify what deserves deeper care. Give your inner response time to settle before deciding how to act externally.
Lunar.1: A lunar eclipse in the first house brings the relationship between identity and feeling into view. You may notice that the image you have maintained no longer fully reflects your current needs. An emotional response can reveal where self-protection has become too rigid or where authenticity wants more room. Others may also react to the change in your presence. Allow the adjustment to be gradual; a clearer sense of self often emerges after you stop defending an outdated version of it.
Lunar.2: Material security may carry more emotional weight than usual during this eclipse. Spending patterns, possessions, or questions of income can reveal what you have been using to create reassurance. The deeper issue may be self-trust rather than money alone. A practical review of resources can be grounding when it is paired with compassion for the needs beneath your choices. Release what is maintained only from fear, and direct attention toward forms of support that can last.
Lunar.3: The lunar eclipse can bring a conversation, message, or local situation to a point of recognition. Feelings that have remained unspoken may be difficult to ignore, especially among siblings, neighbors, or daily contacts. The challenge is to communicate without turning emotion into a weapon or withdrawing from the exchange entirely. Listen for what is being said beneath the first reaction. A more honest pattern of dialogue may begin once each person has room to name their actual experience.
Lunar.4: Family history and private emotional needs are illuminated here. A household change or resurfacing memory may show you which inherited expectations still shape your sense of safety. The eclipse can close a chapter without erasing its significance. What matters is whether your present environment supports the person you are now. Offer care to the parts of yourself that learned to adapt early, then let your living space and boundaries reflect the kind of steadiness you need.
Lunar.5: Romance, creativity, and pleasure are brought to an emotional threshold by this eclipse. A desire that has been minimized may become harder to set aside, while a pastime or connection that once felt lively could reveal its limits. The point is not to chase intensity for its own sake. It is to recognize what genuinely restores your sense of aliveness. Let your response be informative: joy, envy, tenderness, and disappointment can all indicate where your creative life wants a more honest shape.
Lunar.6: The lunar eclipse in the sixth house draws attention to the emotional side of routines, health, and responsibility. Exhaustion may be a message about workload, boundaries, or the way care has been postponed. A work situation can also reveal where your effort is needed and where it is being overextended. Sustainable habits are usually built through adjustment rather than self-criticism. Take the signal seriously, then choose changes that your actual schedule and energy can support.
Lunar.7: Close relationships may reach a moment of clarity during this eclipse. A compromise, dependency, or recurring disagreement can become more visible when emotions are near the surface. This does not automatically mean a connection is ending; it may show what a healthier exchange would require. Vulnerability has more value when it is met with responsiveness. Speak from your experience, leave room for the other person's reality, and notice whether mutual care is genuinely available.
Lunar.8: Shared money, intimacy, and private fears can surface with particular force now. A financial entanglement or emotional bond may need clearer terms, especially where unspoken expectations have accumulated. The eclipse can reveal what has been held too tightly and what has been left undefined. There is strength in recognizing a dependency without shaming yourself for having it. Explore the practical and emotional agreements involved, then make changes that increase trust without erasing your autonomy.
Lunar.9: A belief, educational path, or longing for wider experience may reach a point of emotional resolution. You could find that an old certainty no longer explains what you are learning through direct experience. This is not a failure of conviction; it is an invitation to let understanding become more nuanced. Encounters with other places, cultures, or ideas may be especially revealing. Follow the questions that deepen empathy, and allow your worldview to become more spacious without losing its grounding.
Lunar.10: The lunar eclipse brings career direction and public responsibility into an emotional frame. A role, ambition, or authority dynamic may show you what success has been costing and what it still offers. Recognition can be meaningful, yet it is worth asking whether the path also supports your well-being. A professional transition may begin with an internal decision long before it is visible to others. Honor the information you receive, then take the next step with both purpose and proportion.
Lunar.11: Friendships and collective goals may shift as this eclipse clarifies where you belong. A group dynamic can reveal whether you are participating from genuine affinity or from habit, loyalty, or fear of exclusion. Some connections will deepen through honesty, while others may naturally loosen. Neither outcome needs to be treated as failure. Let the change show you which forms of community support your hopes, and which ones ask you to make yourself smaller to remain included.
Lunar.12: A lunar eclipse in the twelfth house can bring hidden feelings, long-held grief, or private exhaustion into awareness. What emerges may not be ready for public explanation, and there is no need to force it into one. Rest, reflection, and trusted support can make the underlying pattern easier to understand. An ending may first appear as a quiet recognition that a coping strategy has run its course. Give yourself privacy while you decide what release and restoration will look like.

Conjunction.Vertex: Lunar eclipses on the Vertex have a way of making the previously unacknowledged impossible to overlook. What arrives now may carry emotional weight, relational significance, or the quiet force of something that has been building toward this moment for longer than it appears. A person, realization, or circumstance surfaces and asks to be genuinely seen. Resist the urge to process it too quickly. What a contact like this brings tends to mean more the longer you are willing to sit with it.

Opposition.Vertex: Something arrives through the relational axis that is harder to receive than to deflect. A lunar eclipse opposing your Vertex can surface tension between what you need and what a person, institution, or circumstance is currently delivering — not as punishment, but as information. The Vertex does not reach out; it receives. What is being brought to you now, even under pressure, belongs to the current chapter. Let the friction be clarifying. What feels like a confrontation may turn out to be an honest introduction.
